use_cases.title: Firmware and software supply-chain compromise exposure
use_cases.objective: Identify synthetic indicators of potentially compromised, altered, unexpected, or unverifiable vendor firmware and software artifacts while preserving human review and avoiding any deployment or execution action.
observable_evidence: artifact hash or integrity metadata mismatch
deployment metadata inconsistent with the approved maintenance window
asset inventory and supplied artifact metadata mismatch
safety_boundaries: No software package is installed or deployed.
No code or supplied artifact is executed.
No account, network, or security control is modified.
All recommendations remain review-only and require human approval.
acceptance_criteria: Supply-chain evidence is distinguishable from normal maintenance activity.
Artifact provenance and integrity evidence are displayed separately from inferred impact.
Affected and suspected assets remain explicitly separated.
The dashboard clearly identifies synthetic evidence and review-only recommendations.
No operational deployment or execution action is performed.
